# Trump approval takes another hit: Poll

President Trump’s approval rating dipped again this week, following a downward trend in support for the president amid the ongoing Iran war and mounting affordability concerns ahead of November’s midterms.

The latest survey from The Economist/YouGov, published Monday, found 33 percent of respondents said they approved of how Trump has handled his job as president. Another 62 percent indicated they disapproved. [...] Support for the president was split largely along partisan lines, with 79 percent of GOP respondents and only 4 percent of Democratic respondents approving of Trump’s job performance, according to the poll.

results.content: President Trump’s approval rating has remained stagnant at the lowest point between his two presidencies, according to a new poll. The latest Reuters/Ipsos survey shows that Trump’s approval rating has remained at 33 percent — the third time the pollsters have found this result — amid the unpopularity of the Iran war and rising prices. The same poll found that 71 percent of respondents said they do not approve of Trump’s handling of the cost of living, which has become one of the top issues for voters during this primary election season and beyond. A plurality of voters, at 47 percent, said the cost of living would be the most important factor in deciding whom to support in November. Registe
